contexts.text: When truths are distorted, they become truths no longer, but are as it were distorted into the opposite.
The interior form itself... is depraved, and, so to speak, distorted...
Their faces are not distorted... But in the other life their faces successively become so deformed and distorted...
The things which are evil and distorted in the interiors...
The forms of the interiors are distorted from hereditary evil... and what is distorted from this birth can by no means be restored...
